title: DLL Sideloading with the Windows Bluetooth File Transfer Wizard
author: sonny
description: KQL analysis lab of malicious DLL sideloading via the Windows Bluetooth File Transfer Wizard. Demonstrates loading from a user dir and how to detect the behavior using MDE telemetry.
body:
KQL analysis lab of malicious DLL sideloading via the Windows Bluetooth File Transfer Wizard. Demonstrates loading from a user dir and how to detect the behavior using MDE telemetry.

See https://detection.wiki/labs/dll-sideloading-with-the-windows-bluetooth-file-transfer-wizard/ for full KQL queries and telemetry walkthrough.
queries: DeviceImageLoadEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName == "fsquirt.exe" and FolderPath startswith "C:\\Users"
